testimonials.title: What Our Students Say
testimonials.subtitle: Hear from our dance community
testimonials.tangtangQuote: I love music, and dance helps me feel and express music better, making me more confident. In Teacher Bao's class, she always encourages me to overcome challenges and master the basics of dance.
testimonials.tangtang2Quote: I love food, music, dance, art, and reading. Teacher Bao's classes inspire me to keep going, and I often sing along while practicing the moves she taught us.
testimonials.gegeQuote: I love dance, I love Mulan, and I love Teacher Bao even more. Following Teacher Bao for many years, I love how ballet forms the foundation for all dance styles, and especially the Chinese-style contemporary and jazz that deepen my understanding of dance as an art.
testimonials.gege2Quote: 加油我的小妹妹们，你们一定也会爱上舞蹈，爱上Mulan，爱上鲍老师的。

about.title: About Us
about.intro_intro: Mulan Dance Studio was founded by Teacher Bao Junwei in 2021 in Ottawa, Canada, specializing in early childhood dance education and professional youth training.
about.intro_created: Founded in 2021 by Teacher Bao Junwei in Ottawa, Canada.
about.intro_experience: Drawing on Teacher Bao's many years of experience in children's dance education and leading students to compete at the highest national dance competitions, we've developed a unique teaching model and philosophy.

philosophy.title: Teaching Philosophy
philosophy.heading: Learn Through Joy, Learn Through Thinking, Learn Through Understanding
philosophy.desc: Under this teaching philosophy, students not only learn solid dance fundamentals, but also experience the joy that dance brings. Through dance as an art form, students can discover and feel the charm of China's 5,000 years of culture, freely exploring the world of dance art.

goals.title: Our Goals
items: Understand various dance styles and performance modes
Experience the perfect fusion of art and body through systematic teaching
Inspire students' interest and confidence in learning
Develop teamwork spirit and stage presence

history.title: Our History
history.founded: Founded in 2021 by Teacher Bao Junwei

leadership.title: Our Faculty
leadership.founderDesc: Founder of Mulan Dance Studio with many years of children's dance education experience. Specializes in Classical Chinese Dance, Chinese Folk Dance, Ballet, and Contemporary. Creator of the "Learn Through Joy, Think, and Understand" teaching philosophy. Known for inspiring students to overcome challenges and build confidence while integrating traditional Chinese culture into dance teaching.
leadership.kayleyDesc: One of Ottawa's most dynamic dance instructors with extensive competition and performance experience.
kayleyAchievements: 2022 Shandong Children's Spring Gala Outstanding Choreography Director
China-Korea Street Dance Exchange Competition Third Prize
Invited Guest at China Dance Festival
Invited Guest at Beijing Yukou Cultural Festival
Invited Guest at Tangshan May Fourth Youth Day
Top 8 at 'Keep the Love' Freestyle Competition
Top 8 at Qingdao Battle of the Wings 2v2 Freestyle
Runner-up at Weifang Dance Out Miracles Group Competition
Personal resume included in China Youth Talent Database
Studied at Dance邦, HelloDance, Old Dog and other renowned dance studios
Collaborated with artists: Zhuo Hai Tun, Wang OK, Li Tianze, Li Peiling, Park Jae-jung, Zhou Shen, Zhang Yuzi Stage 2023 Finals
leadership.haileyDesc: Hailey Smith holds a Bachelor's degree in Cognitive Science with a concentration in Neuroscience and a minor in Linguistics. She brings strong technical foundation and competitive experience to her teaching.
haileyAchievements: Top 24 at Youth America Grand Prix
Strong styles: Ballet, Jazz, and Acro
Acro is a particular passion with extensive teaching experience

vision.title: Our Vision
items: Become a benchmark in Chinese-language dance education in Ottawa
Help Chinese-speaking children overseas receive systematic professional dance education
Pass on and promote Chinese traditional culture through dance art
Create a warm and caring dance learning community

performance.title: Performances
performance.allSubtitle: Browse student showcases, competitions, and special performance events.
performance.seasonSubtle: Annual Student Showcase + Xiaohe Fengchi Competition
performance.seasonDesc: Mulan Dance Studio holds annual student showcases where every student has the opportunity to shine on their own stage, plus participation in the highest-level children's dance competition in China.

showcase.title: Annual Student Showcase
showcase.desc: Held every mid-year or end of year, every student has the chance to showcase their talent on the dedicated stage. Students learn from each other, inspiring interest in dance. Outstanding students receive the title of "Little Dance King" at Mulan Dance Studio.

xiaohe.title: Xiaohe Fengchi Children's Dance Competition
xiaohe.desc: The highest-level children's dance competition in China. Mulan Dance Studio students have achieved outstanding results, providing our students with a high-level competitive and exhibition stage.

summer.title: Summer Camp Demo Performance
summer.desc: Summer camp graduation showcase, presenting what students have accomplished after a week of intensive training.

programs.title: Programs
programs.subtitle: Comprehensive dance training for every age and level

ballet.title: Ballet
ballet.description: Our ballet program provides a solid foundation with systematic training, using ballet as the basis for all other dance disciplines.

contemporary.title: Contemporary
contemporary.description: Creative Chinese-style modern dance that encourages deep thinking, integrating traditional Chinese cultural elements into contemporary movement.

chinese.title: Classical Chinese Dance
chinese.description: Classical Chinese dance rich in Chinese cultural heritage, inheriting and passing on traditional Chinese dance art through systematic training.

jazz.title: Jazz
jazz.description: Fashionable commercial and performance jazz with a distinctive Chinese style, helping students understand the art of dance through a blend of Western and Eastern influences.

hiphop.title: Hip-Hop
hiphop.description: Trendy street dance training class led by our popular instructor Teacher Yezi, one of Ottawa's most beloved dance teachers. Learn everything from foundational moves to complex choreography.

summer.title: Summer Camp
summer.description: Intensive dance programs during school holidays for ages 5-17. A one-week immersive dance experience covering ballet, Chinese dance, contemporary, jazz, and more.
